reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that enhances session navigation with pinned sessions and adds session actions for copying IDs, exporting Markdown, and permanently deleting sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 增强会话导航，提供置顶分组以及复制会话 ID、导出 Markdown 和永久删除会话等菜单操作。
summaries.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness Web session navigation with a pinned group and menu actions to copy session IDs, export Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.

capabilities: Adds session menu actions for copying IDs, pinning sessions, exporting Markdown, and permanently deleting sessions
Adds a collapsible pinned-session group to the sidebar with drag sorting
Stores pinned-session metadata in a local JSON file
Writes session IDs to the clipboard and exports structured session records
